prompt: Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in League Gothic and reading text in Inter; narrow display hierarchy with neutral body text. Use Spectrum 1-7: page #FBF9FA, text #2D1F20, accent #865C1D, secondary surface #E7EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 14px, heading 28px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
